objective: Compose one sanitized collaboration candidate from settled source-analysis, visual-specification, and session-context contribution packets.
requestedOutcome: A candidate collaboration bundle and evidence manifest that preserve contribution provenance and ownership separation without activating roles or modifying reusable framework source.
successEvidence: Each admitted contribution resolves to a settled sanitized packet and validation result.
Mutable assignment, acknowledgement, and session state remain under the task-local .collab/memory namespace.
The candidate records .collab/artifacts as run evidence and artifacts/loop-architecture as reusable source only.
Stale instruction-governance-editor and AGENTS.md write-boundary claims are absent from the candidate revision.
Unsettled, conflicting, rejected, and unknown claims remain explicit.
nonGoals: Modifying artifacts/loop-architecture or another canonical framework owner.
Activating an Agent, profile, Workflow, writer, editor, validator, or dynamic blueprint.
Accepting or publishing a production PDF.
boundedDiscoverySurface: The selected book-PDF task artifact directory and its predecessor bundle, route, and agency records.
Settled sanitized contribution packets from the source-analysis and visual sessions.
Metadata-only task-local working-memory binding and operation state.
Exact reusable-artifact inventory entries admitted by a validated operation request.
validation: JSON parsing, digest verification, reference resolution, and contribution-settlement checks.
Independent review before any acceptance or activation decision.
materialChangeSignals: Objective, native owner, artifact revision, participant, contribution, effect, route, lifecycle, or protected constraint changes.
stopConditions: A required contribution packet is unsettled or contradicts its source evidence.
A peer memory namespace would need to be merged or private content disclosed.
The task would require canonical framework change, Agent activation, or output acceptance.
